int_name: N HOWARD ST & W ROCKLAND ST

result.summary: The environment is highly industrial with no dedicated pedestrian infrastructure such as sidewalks or marked crossings. A large commercial vehicle is parked in a way that obstructs the pedestrian path and sightlines near an active auto service business.

hazards.name: Large truck obstruction
hazards.description: A large green truck is parked on the apron/roadway edge, forcing pedestrians into the street and blocking sightlines.

hazards.name: Lack of sidewalk
hazards.description: No dedicated, protected space for pedestrians to walk safely away from vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Poor surface condition
hazards.description: Wet and uneven pavement near the garage entrance could cause slips or trips.

interventions.title: Install a sidewalk
interventions.description: Construct a raised, paved sidewalk to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic and driveway aprons.

interventions.title: Parking restrictions
interventions.description: Implement and enforce 'No Parking' zones to prevent large vehicles from obstructing pedestrian paths and sightlines.

interventions.title: Street lighting
interventions.description: Install street lights to improve visibility for pedestrians and drivers in this industrial area.

result.summary: The street environment is characterized by a lack of dedicated pedestrian crossing infrastructure and significant visual obstructions from parked vehicles. While a sidewalk exists on one side, it is narrow and partially obstructed, and the presence of a large moving truck on the opposite side creates a major barrier and safety hazard.

hazards.name: Major Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large moving truck parked on the left side completely blocks sightlines for pedestrians and drivers.

hazards.name: Lack of Designated Crossings
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks are visible, requiring pedestrians to cross the two-lane road without guidance or protection.

hazards.name: Parked Vehicle Obstructions
hazards.description: Continuous street parking on the right side creates potential 'dart-out' hazards and limits visibility at the curb.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to provide designated and visible crossing points for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near potential crossing points to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at potential crossing locations to shorten the crossing distance and prevent vehicles from parking too close to corners.

result.summary: The image depicts a mixed-use intersection with sidewalks present but lacking essential pedestrian safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and curb ramps. Visibility at the crossing is partially compromised by parked vehicles and a utility pole obstructing the sidewalk path.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: No designated pedestrian crossing markings are visible at the intersection, increasing exposure risk.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection foreground and side street entrance

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked near the corner reduce the visibility of pedestrians to approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs near the intersection

hazards.name: Sidewalk obstruction
hazards.description: A utility pole is located within the sidewalk path, narrowing the accessible width for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to shorten crossing distances and improve sightlines by preventing parking too close to the intersection.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at all crossing points to ensure accessibility.

result.summary: The street provides a sidewalk on the residential side but lacks any marked pedestrian crossings or traffic control infrastructure. Sightlines are significantly compromised by parked vehicles and a large truck on both sides of the roadway.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked cars on the left and a large truck on the right block sightlines between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the roadway in the foreground and midground.

hazards.name: Lack of Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or pedestrian warning signs are visible, making it unclear where pedestrians should cross.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks to designate safe crossing points.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten crossing distances and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight beyond parked cars.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Add signage to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians.
